_: Stack packs for review signals (lib/reviewPacks.js). One pack per stack: how it is detected from the manifests, the signals it adds in the review.signals format, and examples that are tests (hit: the line must hit its signal; miss: no signal may hit). Turned on per project with review.packs, after the owner says yes on the Checks tab. A project adds or replaces a pack with a file in docs/queue/review-packs/<id>.json.

raw-sql.text: Raw SQL built from data, or an ORM escape hatch that skips parameters (SQL injection).

access-rule.text: A rule that opens access: public routes, anonymous endpoints, database or storage rules, definer functions.

cors-csrf.text: CORS opened up, CSRF protection switched off, or cookie flags weakened.

deserialize.text: Deserializing data into objects (pickle, Marshal, ObjectInputStream, BinaryFormatter, unsafe YAML).

code-exec.text: A shell command or code evaluated from data (command injection, eval).

file-upload.text: Receiving a file from a user (type, size, path and where it is stored).

tls-off.text: Certificate checks switched off for an outgoing connection.
